title: 18 things you can do this November in Milan
excerpt: Wonderful exhibitions, panettone competitions, events to meet new people, Christmas and Thanksgiving: what to join in Milan this November.
intro: Hello November! Wonderful exhibitions, panettone competitions, events to meet new people, Christmas and Thanksgiving: these are just some of the events you can join this November in Milan.

items.title: Enjoy jazz concerts all over the city
items.description: Join the JAZZMI festival, where iconic Milanese venues host unique concerts exploring the full spectrum of classic and contemporary jazz.

items.title: Join the Panettone World Cup
items.description: The best master pastry chefs from around the world will compete for the title of Panettone World Champion at Melià hotel.
